name: Supabase
how_to_set: Organization > Billing > Cost control: keep "Spend cap" ON (the default on Pro).
Count compute separately: each project adds compute hours that the spend cap does not cover.
kill_switch: With the spend cap on, usage beyond the quota is restricted instead of billed; pause a project to stop its compute.
traps: Spend cap does not cover compute, read replicas, branching compute, IPv4, PITR, custom domain, log drains, extra disk IOPS/throughput, phone MFA
Free projects pause after a week of inactivity
It is a switch, not a dollar amount
